name: Vincent van Gogh
findings: Within his own canvases, tumbleweed turns up as a small accent in 50% of the paintings that hold it, 2.8x the archive's rate (from 2222 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, maize turns up as the lightest note in 83% of the paintings that hold it, 2.3x the archive's rate (from 2222 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, blue turns up as the shadow in 50% of the paintings that hold it, 3.3x the archive's rate (from 2222 paintings here).
Rarely uses smoky black, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 2222 paintings here).
Rarely uses dark olive brown, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 2222 paintings here).
Pairs ferruginous with hay's russet more than chance would predict (3 of 2222 paintings here).
Pairs antique green with dark slate grey more than chance would predict (3 of 2222 paintings here).
His single largest palette family (smoky black, dark jungle green, black olive) covers 54% of his paintings here.
